source: Decompiled Assembly-CSharp.dll from the 2015 Unity build (ilspycmd).

israeli.external_raw: palestinian president + palestinian people + 0.33*(usa + un + arab world)

palestinian.internal_raw: 1.25*tolerance + palestinian public approval + fatah approval + economy + government authority + 0.75*hamas approval
palestinian.external_raw: 1.5*leadership + 1.25*israeli prime minister approval + usa approval + 0.75*(israeli public approval + un approval + arab world approval)

score_formulas.map_rule: raw<zero_at: (raw-zero_at)/zero_at*100 ; zero_at<=raw<=full_at: (raw-zero_at)/(full_at-zero_at)*100 ; raw>full_at: 100 ; truncated to int

budget_modifier_rule: first row whose bound > value; e.g. value 40 -> 1.25
threshold_condition: #Threshold(x, t, v) passes when x >= Uniform(t-v, t+v)
roll_condition: #Roll(name, n) stores UniformInt[0, n-1] in a temp variable

ai.initial_sleep_if_affected_by_difficulty: call_frequency + 3 + 3 + UniformInt[0, N]; N = violent 3, tense 4, calm 8

plot_points: checked once per turn after AI; condition must hold on hold_for+1 consecutive checks; at most one fires per turn; win/lose ends the game
end_report_rule: tier by final 'endreport' variable: >150 EXTREME, >100 HIGH, >50 MODERATE, >0 LOW, else NONE
